overall: The AG found the School Committee's April 1 notice sufficiently specific: a Superintendent's update on his own hiring needed no names or positions, so no Open Meeting Law violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 1 meeting notice, which listed an 'Administrator Search Update' under the Superintendent's report, was insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: The “Administrator Search Update” item was not required to identify the specific administrator positions or finalists’ names about which the Superintendent would report to the Committee, because the Superintendent merely provided an update to the Committee about the latest developments in his own hiring process.
